<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

The DeepGEMM contiguous MoE path currently executes clamped SwiGLU activation, per-token group FP8 quantization, and scale-layout conversion as separate operations.
This introduces additional kernel launches and materializes an intermediate BF16 activation tensor. Fuse these operations to reduce memory traffic and launch overhead while preserving the existing numerical behavior.
The optimization is independent of context parallelism.

## Modifications

- Extend the existing contiguous activation–quantization CUDA kernel to support BF16 intermediate rounding and TMA-aligned FP32 scale output.

- Add shape-dependent rows-per-CTA selection.

- Integrate the fused kernel into the eligible DeepGEMM contiguous MoE path.

- Keep the existing implementation as the fallback for unsupported configurations.

- Add an opt-in environment variable, disabled by default:
```bash
export SGLANG_DEEPGEMM_FUSE_ACTIVATION_QUANT=1

sglang serve \
  --model-path /path/to/model \
  --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm
```
-Add registered correctness tests and an operator microbenchmark.

## Accuracy Tests

Validated on NVIDIA H200:
- 72 correctness tests passed, covering multiple token counts and hidden dimensions, scale layouts, CTA configurations, tail handling, zero/NaN inputs, empty inputs, and CUDA Graph replay.
- Verified exact FP8 output and FP32 scale agreement against the existing separate-operation implementation.
- Tested the real DeepGEMM contiguous execution path, including both grouped GEMMs, with hidden dimensions of 512 and 3072. Outputs were bitwise identical with fusion enabled and disabled.
These are operator-level and runner-level checks; no model-level accuracy claim is made.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Measured on NVIDIA H200 using CUDA Graph timing with rotating input/output buffers to avoid hot-L2-only measurements. Results are the median of five alternating trials per implementation.
The baseline includes activation, FP8 quantization, and scale-layout conversion. The fused implementation performs these operations in one kernel.
| Tokens | Baseline (µs) | Fused (µs) | Speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 8192 | 20.62 | 6.62 | 3.11× |
| 32768 | 61.46 | 21.86 | 2.81× |
| 65536 | 117.20 | 41.97 | 2.79× |

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""Cold-L2 latency of the DeepGEMM down-activation preparation (no GEMMs)."""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.benchmark import marker
+from sglang.kernels.jit.benchmark.utils import create_random
+from sglang.kernels.ops.activation.silu_and_mul_clamp import (
+    silu_and_mul_clamp,
+    silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.ep_moe_kernels import tma_align_input_scale
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import (
+    create_per_token_group_quant_fp8_output_scale,
+    sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(
+    est_time=15, stage="base-b-kernel-benchmark", runner_config="1-gpu-large"
+)
+
+
+def separate(x, activated, q, scale):
+    silu_and_mul_clamp(x, activated, 10.0)
+    sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8(activated, 128, output_q=q, output_s=scale)
+    return q, tma_align_input_scale(scale)
+
+
+def fused(x, q, scale):
+    hidden = q.shape[1]
+    rows_per_cta = 4 if hidden <= 2048 else 2 if hidden <= 4096 else 1
+    silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant(
+        x,
+        q,
+        scale,
+        128,
+        swiglu_limit=10.0,
+        round_to_bf16=True,
+        rows_per_cta=rows_per_cta,
+    )
+    return q, scale
+
+
+def measure(rows, hidden, provider):
+    x = create_random(rows, hidden * 2)
+    q = torch.empty((rows, hidden), device=x.device, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    aligned = provider == "fused"
+    scale = create_per_token_group_quant_fp8_output_scale(
+        q.shape, x.device, 128, aligned, aligned, False
+    )
+    if aligned:
+        fn, args = fused, (x, q, scale)
+    else:
+        activated = torch.empty((rows, hidden), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+        fn, args = separate, (x, activated, q, scale)
+    # All read and written input/output tensors rotate. At the smallest case
+    # the buffers are large enough to avoid the marker's 100-rotation cap.
+    return marker.do_bench(
+        fn,
+        input_args=args,
+        graph_clone_args="all",
+        warmup_iters=5,
+        replay_iters=1000,
+        disable_log_bandwidth=True,
+    )
+
+
+@marker.parametrize("rows", [8192, 32768, 65536, 262144, 294912], [8192, 65536])
+@marker.parametrize("hidden", [512, 2048], [512])
+@marker.benchmark("provider", ["separate", "fused"])
+def benchmark(rows, hidden, provider):
+    return measure(rows, hidden, provider)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    benchmark.run()

@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Preserve the BF16 activation boundary when fusing DeepGEMM's down quantizer."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.activation.silu_and_mul_clamp import (
+    silu_and_mul_clamp,
+    silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.ep_moe_kernels import tma_align_input_scale
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.fp8_kernel import (
+    create_per_token_group_quant_fp8_output_scale,
+    sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="CUDA only")
+
+
+def _reference(x):
+    activated = torch.empty(
+        (x.shape[0], x.shape[1] // 2), device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype
+    )
+    silu_and_mul_clamp(x, activated, 10.0)
+    q, scale = sglang_per_token_group_quant_fp8(activated, 128)
+    return q, tma_align_input_scale(scale)
+
+
+def _fused(x, *, tma_aligned=True, rows_per_cta=None):
+    rows, width = x.shape
+    hidden = width // 2
+    if rows_per_cta is None:
+        rows_per_cta = 4 if hidden <= 2048 else 2 if hidden <= 4096 else 1
+    q = torch.empty((rows, hidden), device=x.device, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = create_per_token_group_quant_fp8_output_scale(
+        q.shape, x.device, 128, tma_aligned, tma_aligned, False
+    )
+    silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant(
+        x,
+        q,
+        scale,
+        128,
+        swiglu_limit=10.0,
+        round_to_bf16=True,
+        rows_per_cta=rows_per_cta,
+    )
+    return q, scale
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 17, 1024, 4237])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden", [256, 512, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 8192])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tma_aligned", [False, True])
+def test_bitwise_matches_deepgemm_reference(rows, hidden, tma_aligned):
+    # FP32-only fusion changes the scale and FP8 bins near BF16 round boundaries.
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    x = (
+        torch.randn(rows, 2 * hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 12
+    ).contiguous()
+    expected_q, expected_s = _reference(x)
+    actual_q, actual_s = _fused(x, tma_aligned=tma_aligned)
+    assert torch.equal(actual_q.view(torch.uint8), expected_q.view(torch.uint8))
+    assert torch.equal(actual_s, expected_s)
+    if tma_aligned:
+        assert actual_s.stride(0) == 1
+        assert actual_s.stride(1) % 4 == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows_per_cta", [1, 2, 4, 8])
+def test_tail_rows_are_not_dropped(rows_per_cta):
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    x = torch.randn(17, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    expected_q, expected_s = _reference(x)
+    actual_q, actual_s = _fused(x, rows_per_cta=rows_per_cta)
+    assert torch.equal(actual_q.view(torch.uint8), expected_q.view(torch.uint8))
+    assert torch.equal(actual_s, expected_s)
+
+
+def test_zero_and_nan_padding_matches_separate_kernels():
+    x = torch.zeros(17, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    x[1].fill_(float("nan"))
+    expected_q, expected_s = _reference(x)
+    actual_q, actual_s = _fused(x)
+    assert torch.equal(actual_q.view(torch.uint8), expected_q.view(torch.uint8))
+    assert torch.equal(actual_s, expected_s)
+
+
+def test_empty_input_does_not_launch_an_empty_grid():
+    q, scale = _fused(torch.empty(0, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+    assert q.shape == (0, 512) and scale.shape == (0, 4)
+
+
+def test_graph_replay_uses_new_input():
+    torch.manual_seed(8)
+    x = torch.randn(1025, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    _fused(x)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        actual_q, actual_s = _fused(x)
+    x.normal_()
+    graph.replay()
+    expected_q, expected_s = _reference(x)
+    assert torch.equal(actual_q.view(torch.uint8), expected_q.view(torch.uint8))
+    assert torch.equal(actual_s, expected_s)
+
+
+def test_existing_fp32_precision_default_is_unchanged():
+    torch.manual_seed(19)
+    x = torch.randn(17, 1024, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    out = torch.empty(17, 512, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    scale = torch.empty(17, 4, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant(x, out, scale, 128, swiglu_limit=10.0)
+    gate, up = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    gate = gate.clamp(max=10).float()
+    up = up.clamp(-10, 10).float()
+    activated = gate * torch.sigmoid(gate) * up
+    expected_s = activated.reshape(17, 4, 128).abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-10) / 448
+    # Rounding the activation to BF16 before absmax violates this FP32 contract.
+    torch.testing.assert_close(scale, expected_s, rtol=2e-6, atol=1e-10)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))
